data.status: plans to open its doors as early as late August or early September 2026
data.short_description: Buffalo Wild Wings plans to open its first Kyle, TX location at 1080 Kohlers Crossing, operated by franchisee DLK Foods. The ~5,500 sq ft restaurant will feature wings, sandwiches, a full bar, and multiple TVs for sports viewing. The Kyle opening is part of a broader Austin-area expansion for the franchisee group.

Juani's Restaurant has closed its previous location on Denton Drive as the owner prepares to relocate to Harry Hines Blvd. The Denton Drive spot sat less than half a mile from the new Harry Hines location. No closing date is specified in the article.

Juani's Restaurant plans to open a standalone location at 10830 Harry Hines Blvd within the Grand Bazaar development, targeted for late 2026. Owner Juana Aguirre built the restaurant from a small gas station taqueria over the past decade. The new location will operate fully independently with no outside administration.

data.location: 1397 N Highland Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30306
data.short_description: Neighborhood restaurant Alere is planned to open in 2027 in Morningside Village at 1397 N. Highland Avenue NE by the team behind The Chastain. The seasonal menu will draw from Southern European cuisine using locally sourced ingredients and classical cooking techniques. The project is still in conceptual development with further details to be announced closer to opening.

data.location: 603 N La Cienega Blvd, West Hollywood, CA 90069
data.status: they hope to open in about a month
data.short_description: The One Rooftop will take over the 16,000-square-foot space at 603 N. La Cienega Blvd formerly occupied by restaurant E.P. & L.P., which shuttered in March. The rooftop concept will feature a lounge, outdoor bar, indoor restaurant space, and rooftop greenspace with views of the Hollywood Hills. The team is still building out the space and hopes to open in approximately one month.

data.location: 7501 W Cermak Rd, North Riverside, IL 60546
data.status: An opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: 7 Brew is confirmed to be opening a new location at North Riverside Park Mall, 7501 W Cermak Road. The timeline for construction is still being evaluated and no opening date has been announced. The drive-thru coffee shop menu includes hot and cold brews, energy drinks, teas, lemonades, and shakes.

Don Ladi's Taco Shop is expanding from its original Gresham location with a second location at 19850 SE Hwy 212 in Damascus, OR, expected to open in August. The family-operated restaurant serves San Diego-style Mexican food including carne asada burritos, breakfast tacos, rolled tacos, shrimp tacos, and weekend menudo. Owner Sonia Lopez confirmed the opening timeline to What Now Portland.

Mazzio's Pizza and Wings in Kilgore, TX permanently closed after 41 years in business, serving its final meal on Friday, July 3. The family-owned restaurant shared the closure announcement on Facebook, thanking the community for over four decades of support. No reason for the closure was provided.

Ship Lantern Inn, a historic fine dining restaurant in Milton, NY, has permanently closed after more than a century of service in the Hudson Valley. Owner Mike Foglia, a third-generation family member, said the closure was due to no family successor being willing to take over the business. According to Reuters Connect, the closure was not due to finances, and Foglia said he hopes to find a new owner for the historic property.

Paris Bistro served downtown Naperville for 13 years before permanently closing on June 7, 2026. The French restaurant announced the closure on social media, thanking guests for their years of support. The restaurant was known for classic French cuisine, an intimate atmosphere, and weekend brunch.

Celebrity-backed burger chain Wahlburgers closed its St. Charles, IL restaurant on June 29, marking the end of the brand's presence in Illinois. The chain plans to open a new location in the future, though no additional details have been announced.

My Pi Pizza in Chicago is listed among three Chicago-area restaurants that served their final meals in June 2026. No address, closing date, or further details about this closure are provided in the article text.

Longtime Woodlands favorite Nona's Italian Grill closed on June 1, 2026, ending its nine-year journey. Founded by Juan Garcia in 2018, the restaurant was known for Northern Italian cuisine, homemade pasta, and a welcoming atmosphere. The restaurant had also expanded with a second location in Montgomery's Woodforest area.

data.location: Garden Oaks, Houston, TX – The Stomping Grounds (Address not specified)
data.short_description: Pho Fix permanently closed its Garden Oaks location at The Stomping Grounds on June 8, 2026, after only five years of operation. The restaurant was known for traditional Vietnamese dishes including slow-simmered pho, vermicelli bowls, and banh mi sandwiches. The menu was inspired by owner Danny Pham's family recipes.

data.location: T.C. Jester Blvd, Houston, TX (Address not specified)
data.short_description: The T.C. Jester Boulevard location of Juanita's Mexican Restaurant announced its closure on social media on June 25, 2026. The family-owned Tex-Mex restaurant had served the community for 25 years. No street address is provided in the article text.
Roswell's Saloon is listed among six Houston-area restaurants that permanently closed in June 2026. No address or specific closing date is provided for this restaurant in the article text.
Blue Tuba is listed among six Houston-area restaurants that permanently closed in June 2026. No address or specific closing date is provided for this restaurant in the article text.

Volcano Steak & Sushi is expanding into McDonough, GA with a new location expected to open in October 2027. The restaurant will occupy approximately 7,000 to 8,000 square feet and feature hibachi entrees and specialty sushi rolls. No street address is provided in the article text.

Decadent Coffee & Dessert Bar is opening a new location in McDonough, GA this year, to be opened by local realtor Simmi Patel. The new location will feature a contemporary design, spacious dining area, and menu items including skillet cookies, fudge brownies, and specialty mochas. No street address or specific opening date is provided in the article.

data.status: expected to open in late summer
data.short_description: Hashtag India is opening a new Sandy Springs location following its metro Atlanta debut in Suwanee, expected to open in late summer. The new location will occupy a 5,900-square-foot space. No street address is provided in the article text.

Huey Magoo's is opening its new Hialeah location at 457 Hialeah Drive with a grand opening ribbon-cutting ceremony on July 11, 2026, at 11 a.m. The opening marks the brand's 90th restaurant nationwide and its second Miami-Dade location, following a Palmetto Bay opening in May 2025. Grand opening promotions include a free 5-Piece Tender Meal offer through July 15 and a "Free Chicken for a Year" giveaway.

Piccolo Ristorante, a family-owned Italian restaurant in Bellmore, NY, permanently closed after a 47-year run, serving its final meal on July 3, 2026. The restaurant was known for traditional Italian cuisine, signature 9-inch pizzas, and classic pasta dishes. Owner Tom Valenti Jr. cited a "myriad of reasons" for the closure, though no specific reason was detailed.

data.status: customer ready at some point in August
data.short_description: Wonder is opening a new food hall location at 13257 Worth Avenue in Smoketown Station, Woodbridge, VA, expected to be customer ready sometime in August 2026. The fast-casual concept partners with high-profile chefs to recreate their signature dishes, with guests able to order from multiple restaurant concepts on one bill. A precise opening date is not yet available.

data.status: will no longer offer sweet treats
data.short_description: Frostings Bake Shop has closed at 4336 Pouncey Tract Road in the Short Pump area of Henrico, VA, with its space being taken over by Lindsey's Sandwich Shop. Both the outgoing and incoming concepts come from Lindsey Food Group. No specific closing date is provided in the article.

data.status: opening timeline for Lindsey's Sandwich Shop remains nebulous
data.short_description: Lindsey's Sandwich Shop is opening at 4336 Pouncey Tract Road in the Short Pump area of Henrico, VA, from founders Mike Lindsey and Kim Love-Lindsey of Lindsey Food Group. The deli will serve lunch and dinner featuring subs, hoagies, focaccia sandwiches, and paninis, with potential future breakfast options. No opening date has been announced.

Kona Grill ceased operations last winter at 1 E. Pratt Street in Baltimore's Inner Harbor, leaving the space vacant. The space is now being taken over by STK Steakhouse. Both Kona Grill and STK Steakhouse are owned by The One Group.

data.status: may be customer ready by early 2027
data.short_description: STK Steakhouse is set to take over the former Kona Grill space at 1 E. Pratt Street in Baltimore's Inner Harbor, with submitted city permits indicating hopes to have signage installed before end of 2026, suggesting an early 2027 opening. The Denver-based concept blends a modern steakhouse with a chic lounge, offering fine dining with high-quality steaks. A definitive opening timeline is not yet available.

data.status: permit granted; opening may be imminent
data.short_description: Jack's Family Restaurant has received a permit from the Mississippi Department of Health to open at 130 Edwards Circle in Flora, MS, though no opening date has been announced. The Flora location is not yet listed on the Jack's website, suggesting an opening may be imminent but is still pending. What Now Memphis has reached out for further details.

El Agave is preparing to open at 5007 Black Road in Memphis, TN, with no official opening date announced, though the restaurant has begun recruiting staff. The Mexican restaurant has been active on social media previewing menu items and confirmed on June 27 that the wait is "almost over." The menu will include authentic Mexican cuisine, handcrafted drinks, margaritas, and chicken wings.

data.status: aiming to open the restaurant the weekend of July 17
data.short_description: Aplós Simple Mediterranean is preparing to open its third location at 803 Sisk Avenue in Oxford, MS, with founder Chef Alex Eaton aiming for the weekend of July 17, 2026, pending final construction and inspections. Already operating in Jackson and Ridgeland, MS, the restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine including hummus bowls, Greek wings, and chicken shawarma. Eaton expressed enthusiasm about becoming part of the Oxford community through school partnerships and local engagement.

data.status: currently on track to open this fall
data.short_description: Shivers Creek Catfish House is opening its fourth location at 422 E. Capitol Street in Jackson, MS, currently on track for fall 2026 with no precise date yet available. The 6,800 sq ft space will offer al fresco dining in both the front and rear, private dining, and will be the first location to offer Mississippi craft beers. The restaurant is known for serving fresh, never frozen Mississippi seafood.

data.location: San Antonio, TX (multiple locations; specific new sites not announced)
data.short_description: P. Terry's plans to add more locations in San Antonio following a transition to an Employee Ownership Trust. No specific sites or opening timelines have been announced. The chain currently operates five San Antonio locations.

data.store_name: Sítio El Tropicano (Emmer & Rye Hospitality Group dining concepts)
data.location: San Antonio River Walk, San Antonio, TX
data.status: set to open (as part of hotel redevelopment)
data.short_description: Emmer & Rye Hospitality Group has been selected to lead food and beverage operations at the restored Sítio El Tropicano hotel on San Antonio's River Walk. Plans include a lobby café and provisions shop, a signature all-day restaurant, and a poolside venue. No opening date has been announced.

Canadian premium-casual dining chain JOEY Restaurants is opening its first Massachusetts location at 250 Northern Avenue in Boston's Seaport, taking over the former Tony C's and Temazcal space. No official opening date has been provided. The globally inspired menu includes burgers, tacos, steaks, sushi, and vegan options.

Dotty's Kitchen & Raw Bar has announced plans to open an on-site coffee shop called Daybreak Coffee & Provisions at 1250 Hancock Street in Quincy. No official menu or opening date has been announced. The café will serve specialty coffee drinks including espresso, lattes, cortados, and matcha.

Chef Michael and Brittany Cooney announced a new Ember & Iron location at 62 Spanish Street in the St. Augustine Historic District. The restaurant will serve the full menu from its current location plus a seafood program influenced by Gemma Fish + Oyster. No opening date has been specified.

Rockham 5G franchise group is awaiting construction permits for a new Five Guys at 3220 Saint Paul Street in Charles Village, Baltimore, taking over the space vacated by Trek Bicycle. The roughly 3,000-square-foot location will seat approximately 70 customers and employ about 50 staff. The group hopes to open before the end of the year.

The Tot Spot Jax, a tater tot food truck based in Jacksonville, appears to be relaunching after its website and social media went dark. Plan review paperwork has been submitted by The Tot Spot Jax Inc, indicating operations will resume. The owner was not immediately available for comment.

Plan review paperwork has been submitted by Renee Willard for a new food truck called Willard BBQ, suggesting a comeback for the former Willard's Bar-B-Q Junction brand. The original brick-and-mortar location at 4610 San Juan Ave in Jacksonville closed in February 2022 due to COVID-19 challenges. Details on the new food truck have not yet been revealed.

Willard's Bar-B-Q Junction closed in February 2022 after 30 years in operation, attributed to COVID-19-related challenges including product scarcity and rising labor costs. The closure is referenced as background context for the new Willard BBQ food truck filing.

data.location: Near intersection of International Golf Parkway and Village Commons Drive, St. Johns County, FL
data.short_description: Plans have been submitted for a new 7 Brew Coffee drive-thru location in St. Johns County near International Golf Parkway and Village Commons Drive. The proposed building is 510 square feet with two drive-thru lanes and 20 parking spaces. An additional St. Johns location has also been proposed at FL-16 and County Road 208.

data.location: FL-16 & Co Rd 208, St. Johns, FL 32092
data.short_description: A second new 7 Brew Coffee location has been proposed in St. Johns County at FL-16 and County Road 208. Plans are part of the brand's continued expansion in Northeast Florida. No additional details have been provided.

Congaree and Penn launched The Roost, a new open-air restaurant at its farm property, on June 19 while its longtime Quonset hut undergoes a major remodel. The Roost serves a seasonal farm-to-table all-day menu including a Farmhouse Burger and Grilled Florida Shrimp. The Quonset hut's last day for dining was June 14.

The Quonset hut restaurant at Congaree and Penn closed on June 14 for a substantial remodel and is being transformed into a fully enclosed, temperature-controlled restaurant called "High Horse," expected to open this winter. Construction began this summer.

Bebos Cajun Kitchen is opening at 117 E Lake Ave, Suite 101 in downtown Auburndale, serving Cajun-style dishes including Po Boys, Shrimp & Grits, Jambalaya, and Gumbo. The restaurant will feature indoor and outdoor seating for approximately 130 guests. No official opening date has been set, but the owner is targeting late September.

Ron's Gourmet Ice Cream is opening a third location at 305 Washington Street in Westwood's Islington neighborhood, taking over the former Juicygreens space. The family-owned creamery confirmed the expansion via social media, with an expected opening in late summer 2026. The location will offer the same handcrafted ice cream lineup as its existing shops.

Juicygreens closed its 305 Washington Street location in Westwood on June 30, with the space being taken over by Ron's Gourmet Ice Cream. The health-focused eatery continues to operate seven other locations across Greater Boston.

Red Mesa Cantina closed its doors at 128 Third St. S in downtown St. Pete in early June 2026 after a 16-year run. The closure came suddenly, leaving the three-story space's future initially unclear. The Rreal Tacos team will be taking over the space with a multi-concept restaurant.

data.status: expected to start opening in early 2027
data.short_description: The team behind Rreal Tacos is opening a new multi-concept restaurant at the former Red Mesa Cantina space at 128 Third St. S in downtown St. Pete. The specific concepts have not yet been revealed; they are expected to begin opening in early 2027 and launch in phases, representing an eight-figure investment and more than 800 total seats.

Calle Bistro is opening at 1544 Main St in downtown Sarasota, promising brunch, dinner, cocktails, and late-night programming according to submitted plan review documents. By day it will offer coffee and brunch; by night it will feature live DJs and late-night bites. No opening date has been announced.

data.store_name: Frozen in Time Gourmet Ice Cream
data.short_description: Submitted plan review documents indicate a new Frozen in Time Gourmet Ice Cream location is planned at 7810 US Hwy 19, Unit A in Port Richey. The brand currently operates a scoop shop in Crystal River and a food truck. The co-owner was not immediately available for comment.

The team behind Spoke Wine Bar is preparing to open Liars Restaurant in the former True Bistro space at 1153 Broadway in Somerville's Teele Square. Little has been revealed about the concept beyond an Instagram description calling it the "bigger baby sister" to Spoke Wine Bar. An opening timeline and additional details are forthcoming.

data.store_name: MAX Ultimate Food (café at Smith Family Pavilion)
data.short_description: Dorchester-based catering company MAX Ultimate Food has been selected to operate a café at the new $24 million Charlesbank and Smith Family Pavilion on the Charles River Esplanade. The all-day café will offer breakfast and lunch fare including coffee, pastries, avocado toast, and seasonal items. The pavilion is expected to open this fall.

Gastronaut, a pan-Russia cocktail bar serving small plates, is opening at 72 MacDougal St in the West Village, taking over the former Parcelle wine bar space. The bar program will be led by the team behind El Copitas in St. Petersburg and will feature a large selection of international vodkas. The menu blends Eastern European flavors with Japanese and East Asian presentations.

data.location: 417 S. Rosemary Avenue, West Palm Beach, FL
data.short_description: BuddhaBerry filed permit applications with the Florida DBPR to open a frozen yogurt shop at CityPlace, 417 S. Rosemary Avenue in West Palm Beach. The location will be the brand's third, joining two existing Hamptons locations in Sag Harbor and Southampton, NY. No specific opening date has been set.

Joystick Gamebar announced that its Edgewood Avenue location in Atlanta will close, with its final day of service scheduled for July 12 after 14 years in operation. The owner did not provide a specific reason for the closure but expressed hope to reopen at a new location. The retro arcade bar is known for coin-operated games, craft cocktails, and themed events.

data.location: 2400 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
data.short_description: Breakwater Hospitality Group has been selected to negotiate an agreement with the City of West Palm Beach to develop a signature restaurant at Currie Park. The proposed concept, Sea Salt Beach House, is described as a modern waterfront destination with approximately 378 seats, covered terraces, and open-air seating. No timeline has been established for the project.

data.location: 2101 E. Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78702
data.short_description: Taqueria Chapala, a family-owned Mexican restaurant in Austin, is expected to close its East Cesar Chavez Street location in September 2026 due to a lease renewal dispute with property owners. The owners were not permitted to renew their lease at any price. The restaurant has two other Austin-area locations that will continue operating.

Lucca, a modern Italian trattoria operated by CM Food Co., officially opened its first Florida location on July 3 at Doral Commons. The restaurant serves house-made Italian dishes, pizzas, pastas, and desserts, and already operates locations in Aruba, Panama, and Venezuela. Doral Commons is a retail complex of over 138,000 square feet anchored by a Publix store.

Cloud Nine Miami, LLC filed permit applications to open Yoghurt & Yoga at 239 Miracle Mile in Coral Gables, transforming the former Edible Arrangements space. The concept combines yoga classes with frozen yogurt, specialty coffee, matcha, and Swedish treats. An official opening date has not been announced, though an Instagram post confirms it will open in September 2026.

Cafe Rothem, a Korean-style bookstore café in Duluth, announced it will close on July 18 after 10 years in the neighborhood. The owners did not reveal a reason for the closure. The café is holding a clearance sale offering 40% discounts on books, CDs, and other retail merchandise prior to closing.

data.location: 319 NE 167th St, North Miami Beach, FL 33162
data.status: An exact opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Sterline Vil filed permit applications to open Double Take Market & Eatery at 319 N.E. 167th Street in North Miami Beach, a combination market and restaurant celebrating Caribbean flavors. The market will feature specialty dry goods, imported Haitian products, premium meats, and fresh seafood, while the restaurant will offer a fusion menu inspired by Haitian, Puerto Rican, Dominican, and American cuisine. An exact opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 1600 N Dixie Hwy, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
data.short_description: Pescatore Ristorante, a family-friendly Italian restaurant in West Palm Beach, served its final meal on June 30 and has permanently closed. The restaurant was known for fresh seafood, artisan pizzas, and homemade breads, and was located inside the former site of Mama Glida's. No official reason for the closure was shared.

data.location: 1131 Uptown Park Blvd Ste 1, Houston, TX 77056
data.short_description: Uptown Sporting Club, a 5,000-square-foot sports and cocktail bar, will officially open on July 4 at Uptown Park in Houston. The concept combines live sports viewing, upscale dining, handcrafted cocktails, and late-night entertainment with DJs. The venue comes from restaurateurs Roveen Abante and Daniel Chang and will host watch parties for major sporting events.

data.location: 3040 Rigel Ave., Suite 120, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.short_description: Nacho Daddy, a Las Vegas-based restaurant chain, is opening its fourth Southern Nevada location on July 3 inside AREA15 at 3040 Rigel Avenue, Suite 120. The nearly 5,000-square-foot restaurant seats more than 200 guests and features a full bar, large patio, and artwork inspired by AREA15. The opening makes Nacho Daddy the only Las Vegas-founded restaurant operating inside AREA15.

Pizza Guys opened a new location at 2794 W. Ball Road in Anaheim on June 18, expanding the Sacramento-based chain's footprint in Orange County. The restaurant serves handcrafted pizzas, wings, sandwiches, and other menu favorites. The Anaheim location is locally owned and operated by Kevin Horbakht.

data.location: 231 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
data.short_description: Ling Nam, a family-owned Filipino-Chinese bakery and restaurant, is opening a new location at 231 Grand Ave in South San Francisco as part of a two-location expansion led by second-generation owner Alexson Lim. The South San Francisco opening carries special significance as the business originally operated in the city for three decades before relocating to Daly City during the pandemic. No opening date has been announced.

data.location: Near BART station, Union City, CA
data.short_description: Ling Nam is also opening a second new location near the BART station in Union City, being opened by Alexson Lim and his wife in the community where they live. The Union City location, described as an Express concept, was selected for its growing Filipino community and proximity to public transit. No address or opening date has been announced.

data.status: closing by the end of this month
data.short_description: Walnut Street Kitchen, a fine-dining Filipino-American restaurant in Montclair, will permanently close on July 31, with the adjacent Walnut St. Bagels & Co. also shutting down. Owner and executive chef Beverly Lacsina cited industry challenges, difficult economic conditions, and post-pandemic workforce struggles as the reasons for closure. Prior to closing, the restaurant will host a Filipino-American pop-up dining experience called Bunso from July 7 through July 31.

Walnut St. Bagels & Co., the bakery and bagel shop operated next door to Walnut Street Kitchen, will also shut down at the end of July. The closure follows the same decision by owner Beverly Lacsina, who cited industry challenges and difficult economic conditions.

data.status: opened its second Manhattan location on July 1
data.short_description: San Babila Café opened its second Manhattan location on July 1 at 1247 Third Avenue on the Upper East Side. The café serves specialty coffee, gelato, Italian pastries, and light fare throughout the day, and celebrated the opening with free gelato croissants for the first 200 guests. The café was founded by Gianmarco "Gianni" Di Michele, whose family has a long history in Italian hospitality.

Fanoos Grills is preparing to open its second San Francisco location at 411 Columbus Avenue in North Beach, expanding beyond its original Sutter Street location. The restaurant is one of 39 small businesses selected to receive funding through the San Francisco Storefront Opportunity Grant Program, which provides grants of $50,000 to $100,000. No opening date has been announced.

data.status: details about the restaurant's opening date and location have not yet been announced
data.short_description: Properly Seasoned Kitchen, created by Bay Area chef Kyle Best, is among small businesses selected to receive funding through the City of San Francisco's Storefront Opportunity Grant Program to open its first permanent brick-and-mortar location. The restaurant will serve Chef Kyle's signature "Pana Soul" cuisine, blending Panamanian flavors, Southern comfort food, and classic French culinary techniques. Details about the opening date and exact location have not yet been announced.

data.location: 10620 Dean Martin Dr, Suite 100, Las Vegas, NV 89141
data.status: expected to open in the Southern Highlands within the KAKTUSlife plaza
data.short_description: Hawthorne Craft Bar & Kitchen is set to open in the Southern Highlands area of Las Vegas within the KAKTUSlife plaza at 10620 Dean Martin Dr, Suite 100, according to a Clark County permit. The elevated sports bar concept comes from restaurateur Robert Parekh, known for his work with Fontainebleau and Trustworthy Brewing. The brand's website suggests it is on its path to opening this fall.

data.location: 696 Randolph Ave, Ste B, Costa Mesa, CA 92626
data.short_description: Ambitious Ales Brewing is expanding into Orange County with a new taproom at 696 Randolph Ave, Ste B in Costa Mesa, marking its first venture outside of Long Beach. Founded in 2019 in Long Beach's Bixby Knolls neighborhood, the brewery is known for its rotating lineup of lagers, IPAs, saisons, and experimental brews. Additional details about the space and opening festivities have yet to be announced.

Amidulce, a mother-daughter bakery known for modern Mexican desserts, announced a brick-and-mortar location is "coming soon" at 202 Folsom St in downtown San Francisco. The bakery is supported by the City of San Francisco's Storefront Opportunity Grant Program. The exact opening date has not been disclosed.

data.location: 1731 W. Katella Ave., Suite F, Anaheim, CA 92804
data.short_description: Sushi Kani is slated to debut at 1731 W. Katella Ave., Suite F in Anaheim in September, taking over the former home of Rent-A-Center. The restaurant will specialize in fresh sushi, specialty rolls, and high-quality sashimi, operating daily from 5:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. for dinner and late-night dining.

data.status: slated to open in early September 2026
data.short_description: Sergeant Ma, Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group's waterfront restaurant in San Francisco's China Basin neighborhood, is slated to open in early September 2026 at 185 Berry Street, across from Oracle Park overlooking Mission Creek. The restaurant will be led by Executive Chef and Partner Jason Halverson and will showcase California cuisine rooted in Asian tradition. Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group will also operate an adjacent daytime café, Waters Edge, at the same location.

data.status: slated to open in early September 2026
data.short_description: Waters Edge is an adjacent daytime café and community workspace to be operated by Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group alongside Sergeant Ma at 185 Berry Street. The café will serve coffee, breakfast, and casual lunch fare. No separate opening date is mentioned beyond the Sergeant Ma opening timeline of early September 2026.

data.location: 204 S Decatur Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89107
data.status: expected to open sometime this year
data.short_description: A new Dollar Tree is expected to open at Decatur Crossing in West Las Vegas per a City of Las Vegas permit. The brand has begun hiring for the new store, though no exact opening date has been announced.

Fiore del Vino, a women-owned wine window concept inspired by Florentine buchette del vino, is set to open in downtown Sacramento near the State Capitol. The walk-up window will serve European and local wines, beers, and artisan small bites, with a spacious patio.

data.status: slated to wrap up by November of next year
data.short_description: Flower Child, a health-focused fast-casual concept, is expected to open at the Dunham Pointe development in Cypress. Construction is planned for a May 2027 start and is slated to wrap up by November 2027, pending permitting on the $1.3 million project.

data.location: 12515 Northlake Blvd, Suite 110, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33412
data.short_description: Carmela Coffee is opening a new café at Avenir Town Center in Palm Beach Gardens as part of the mixed-use development's phased opening beginning in summer 2026. The farm-to-cup coffeehouse will offer espresso drinks, specialty coffees, teas, lemonades, and an all-day breakfast menu.

data.location: 18318 E Chandler Heights Rd, Suite 102, Gilbert, AZ 85298
data.status: construction expected to take about six months before the new cafe is ready to open
data.short_description: Charlee Rose Coffee is expanding in Gilbert with a second location after owners Brandy and Brianna Grice signed a lease at 18318 E. Chandler Heights Rd. Construction is expected to take about six months before the new café is ready to open.

data.location: 5920 Coral Ridge Dr, Coral Springs, FL
data.status: expected to open the end of July 2026
data.short_description: Ember & Vine, an all-day dining concept by P Hospitality Management, will open at Sawgrass Center in Coral Springs. The restaurant will serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily in a bright, contemporary space with a menu featuring globally inspired seasonal dishes.

data.status: opening is currently targeted for Q4 2026
data.short_description: A new Jersey Mike's Subs is planned for Hopkins Marsh Lane Plaza in Dallas, per public filings. Franchisee Mark Melendez confirmed the Q4 2026 target, though construction bids are still pending and a more precise timeline is expected in the coming weeks.

data.status: slated to be customer-ready early next year
data.short_description: Dave & Buster's is taking over the space vacated by H&M at Annapolis Mall and is slated to open early next year. The location will feature a full-service restaurant, an extensive video arcade, and a multi-screen sports bar.

data.status: reopened on June 27 after closing in May
data.short_description: PJ's Daily Grind reopened in Superior, Colorado, on June 27 following a rebrand from its former name PJ Foods. The café held a soft opening and continues to serve handcrafted coffee, scratch-made pastries, and breakfast offerings.

Kingdom Sushi is preparing to open its first Winter Garden location on Miley Dr, near Hamlin Town Center and the Horizon West community. The chain's website lists the location as "Coming Soon" with no announced opening date.

data.status: will temporarily close during the renovation
data.short_description: Maison Dupuy Hotel has been acquired by the Valentino family, who plan a $13 million renovation ahead of a 2027 reopening as part of Hilton's Curio Collection. The 200-room hotel will temporarily close during the renovation, with upgrades planned for guest rooms, public spaces, and a new restaurant concept.

Following its temporary closure for renovation, Maison Dupuy Hotel plans to reopen in 2027 as part of Hilton's Curio Collection. The $13 million renovation will include upgraded guest rooms, public spaces, new furnishings, and a new restaurant concept.

data.location: The Yard at Harvest, Woodinville, WA (Address not specified)
data.status: expected to open in late spring or early summer 2027
data.short_description: Chef Hari Nayak is bringing a new, yet-unnamed Indian restaurant concept to The Yard at Harvest development in Woodinville, his first Seattle-area restaurant. The concept will feature dishes from across India centered around charcoal grilling and tandoor cooking, along with a cocktail and Pacific Northwest wine program.

data.location: 597 Markham St, Toronto, ON M6G 0B3, Canada
data.status: expected to open in early fall 2026
data.short_description: Cremma Gelato, a new Italian-inspired gelato shop from Michael Marshall and chef Graziano Totora, is preparing to open at 597 Markham Street within the Mirvish Village development in Toronto. The shop will focus on authentic Italian-style gelato with distinctive serving formats such as gelato in a warm brioche bun.

Pâtisserie Mélanie closed earlier in 2026 after operating for less than two years at 3750 30th Street in San Diego's North Park neighborhood. The space will be taken over by Nana Fran's, a new restaurant from the owners of Mabel's Gone Fishing and Bodega Rosette.

data.status: set to move into the former home of Pâtisserie Mélanie
data.short_description: Nana Fran's, a new neighborhood restaurant from owners Chelsea Marlene Coleman and Rae Ellen Gurne, is set to open in San Diego's North Park at the former Pâtisserie Mélanie location. A pending Type 41 beer and wine license has been applied for; an exact opening date has not yet been announced.

KoJa Kitchen is closing its location at 732 K Street in downtown Sacramento, with franchise owner Thomas Quach and his team staying at The Hardin address. A social media announcement teased that "a new chapter is coming to 732 K St. soon," signaling a concept refresh or rebrand is planned for the space.

data.status: moving, and we're making it bigger and better
data.short_description: Pence Farm Sourdough, a family-owned bakery in downtown Sonora, is relocating from 147 S. Washington to a new space at 123 S. Washington Street. A temporary liquor license permit has already been issued, allowing operations at the new space while the permanent license is finalized. The owners have also filed for a Caterer Permit and an Event Permit, suggesting the new space will expand beyond a bakery counter.

Mission BBQ is joining the Westgate Plaza redevelopment project in Toledo, Ohio, marking the brand's first location in the city. An exact address and opening date have not been announced as it is early in the construction process. The restaurant is part of a larger redevelopment that also includes Trader Joe's among new tenants.

The brand is currently remodeling the former Born and Raised Centennial spot. An official opening date has not yet been confirmed, though September 1st has been mentioned as a target.
